title: Matrix product verification predicate
statement: Let $A$, $B$, and $C$ be $n\times n$ matrices over the field with two elements, and let $x$ be a vector in the $n$-dimensional vector space over that field. The matrix product verification predicate holds at $x$ exactly when $Cx=A(Bx)$ coordinatewise.
